title: Clopen restriction coproduct preservation and zero-insertion adjunction
statement: For each component of a finite disjoint clopen cover, restriction preserves all displayed discrete colimits and every zero-insertion functor satisfying the component identity and off-diagonal zero conditions is right adjoint to restriction.

source.place: Tags 0GMW and 0FPQ: coproduct preservation and the zero-insertion adjunction.

proof.text: Choose an equivalence from Fin (Fintype.card I) to I and reindex the finite clopen partition. Surjectivity transports the covering hypothesis, and injectivity transports disjointness. This reduces the index universe to zero without enlarging the prescribed module universe.

Forget only the commutativity of the coefficient rings and apply clopen_ringed_module_gluing to the reindexed partition. Its inverse functor and unit/counit isomorphisms make the tuple of the actual restrictions an equivalence. Retain also the diagonal identity and off-diagonal zero properties of its zero-insertion functors.

For any fully faithful tuple r of functors and any candidate insertion e in coordinate i, send a map M to e(N) to its i-th component followed by the given diagonal isomorphism. This map on Hom sets is injective: faithfulness reduces equality to all coordinates, the diagonal isomorphism cancels at i, and zero targets force equality elsewhere. It is surjective: extend a component morphism by composing with the inverse diagonal isomorphism at i and by the unique maps to zero elsewhere, then take its preimage under the full functor. Functoriality and naturality of the diagonal isomorphism verify both naturality equations, giving the adjunction by Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. This argument is written completely as the private helper adjunctionOfZeroInsertion.

Apply the Hom-set construction to the insertions supplied by gluing. Every component restriction is then a left adjoint, so Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits yields each displayed discrete-colimit preservation instance. Apply the same construction to every insertion in the conclusion, using its own diagonal isomorphism and zero hypotheses. Transport each result back along the finite reindexing equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem clopen_structural_coproduct_adjunction
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (I : Type w) [Finite I] (Y : I → Scheme.{t})
    (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)] [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (j i)]
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i k ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (j i)) (Set.range (j k))))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (j i))
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}) :
    (∀ i (K : Type (max u (t + 1))),
      PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete K) (ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} (j i) R)) ∧
    (∀ i
      (e : ClopenData.clopenTensorModules.{t, u}
        ((ClopenData.clopenTensorRings.{t, u} (j i)).obj R) ⥤
        ClopenData.clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R),
      Nonempty (e ⋙ ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} (j i) R ≅ 𝟭 _) →
      (∀ k, k ≠ i → ∀ N, IsZero ((e ⋙ ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} (j k) R).obj N)) →
      Nonempty (ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} (j i) R ⊣ e))
